yourAssistant.headline: An AI that knows your entire business.
yourAssistant.body: VOIS learns your processes, preferences, history, and context. It doesn't just answer questions — it anticipates needs, drafts responses, and acts on your behalf across every tool you use.
yourAssistant.closingLine: Other assistants need instructions. VOIS already knows.

yourSuperAssistant.headline: Voice, watch, inbox, memory — one brain.
yourSuperAssistant.body: Speak to your watch, dictate in the car, forward an email, or drop a note. Every input lands in one intelligent system that routes, prioritizes, and remembers everything.

yourDay.headline: Every morning, planned for you.
yourDay.body: VOIS reviews your tasks, calendar, deadlines, and priorities overnight. Each morning you get a proposed schedule with themed time blocks, prep notes for meetings, and flagged items that need attention.
yourDay.closingLine: Your day shouldn't start with decisions. It should start with a plan.

meetings.headline: Prepared. Transcribed. Acted on.
meetings.body: Personalized briefings before every meeting. Live transcription with speaker diarization during. Action items extracted and routed to the right projects and people after.
meetings.closingLine: Other tools transcribe. VOIS prepares, captures, and acts.

projects.headline: Know what needs you before it stalls.
projects.body: AI health scoring monitors task completion, activity patterns, and timeline progress. When a project goes quiet or a milestone slips, VOIS flags it proactively and suggests next steps.
projects.closingLine: Dashboards show what happened. VOIS tells you what to do next.

operations.headline: Your business monitors itself.
operations.body: VOIS watches KPIs, workflows, and recurring processes. When something deviates from normal — a delayed delivery, a missed SLA, a budget overrun — it alerts you with context and recommended action.

clients.headline: Every relationship, full context.
clients.body: VOIS builds rich profiles from every interaction — meetings, emails, notes, tasks. Before any conversation you see the full history, sentiment trends, and AI-suggested talking points.
clients.closingLine: Your CRM shouldn't be a database. It should be a memory.

documents.headline: Talk it out. Get a document back.
documents.body: Describe what you need — a project brief, a proposal, a weekly update — and VOIS generates a structured document from your voice, pulling context from your projects and data.
documents.closingLine: Stop staring at blank pages. Start talking.

finance.headline: Every dollar, one view.
finance.body: Revenue, expenses, invoices, and forecasts unified in a single AI-powered dashboard. VOIS categorizes transactions, flags anomalies, and answers natural-language questions about your numbers.

website.headline: Your site, built by AI.
website.body: Describe your business and VOIS generates a complete website — copy, layout, images, SEO. Update it by voice. Connect forms, booking, and payments without touching code.
website.closingLine: Your website shouldn't need a developer.

aiAgents.headline: Your first ten hires don't need salaries.
aiAgents.body: Build your AI team in an org chart. Assign agents to roles — researcher, writer, analyst, ops. Each has responsibilities, tools, budgets, and reporting lines. They plan before acting and pause for approval.
aiAgents.closingLine: ChatGPT answers questions. VOIS agents complete missions.

reports.headline: Speak your report in 90 seconds.
reports.body: Upload a template and VOIS extracts every field. Fill the entire report by voice — AI interviews you one field at a time and pre-fills what it already knows from your data.

yourTeam.headline: Every employee, a super-assistant.
yourTeam.body: Give every team member their own AI assistant that knows company context, processes, and history. Onboarding, daily planning, knowledge lookup, and task management — personalized per role.
yourTeam.closingLine: Scale your best practices to every seat.

playbooks.headline: Your SOPs, alive and enforced.
playbooks.body: Turn standard operating procedures into living workflows. VOIS monitors compliance, guides team members through each step, and flags deviations before they become problems.
playbooks.closingLine: SOPs shouldn't live in binders. They should run themselves.

fieldToOffice.headline: The information gap, eliminated.
fieldToOffice.body: A technician finishes a job and speaks a 30-second update. The office sees it instantly — structured, filed, and linked to the right project, client, and invoice. No phone calls, no data entry.
fieldToOffice.closingLine: The field is never a day behind again.

theAirlock.headline: AI power. Human control.
theAirlock.body: Every AI action goes through the Airlock — a preview card with cryptographic confirmation. The AI proposes, you review the exact output, then approve. Nothing is sent, created, or modified without your explicit sign-off.
theAirlock.closingLine: Trust isn't a setting. It's an architecture.

yourMemory.headline: Ask anything you've ever said or read.
yourMemory.body: Search across all 19 data sources — voice recordings, emails, documents, meeting transcripts, CRM notes — with semantic search. VOIS finds the answer even when you can't remember which app it was in.
yourMemory.closingLine: Your second brain, with perfect recall.

growthEngine.headline: Share a meeting note. Gain a customer.
growthEngine.body: Shared meeting notes become a growth channel. Recipients see your company preview, get a promo offer, and sign up into a workspace pre-seeded from their own company data.
growthEngine.closingLine: Your product sells itself through the work it does.
